page: Microsoft Azure L16as_v5 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the Lasv5 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor, paired with 128.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A primary hardware feature of the L16as_v5 is its 3840 GB of local storage, and the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. The server does not include integrated graphics processing units and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The high local storage capacity relative to the compute allocation provides a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage for workloads requiring significant local data caching or high-density storage operations without the overhead of external storage attachments.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the substantial 3840 GB local storage capacity, this server type is configured for storage-intensive and database workloads. Appropriate use cases include relational databases, NoSQL transactional databases, large-scale data warehousing, and analytics applications that benefit from high-capacity local storage and moderate memory allocations.
